caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher with a round, bulbous body and a short, wide neck that flares outward at the rim. The body of the pitcher displays a gradient of colors, transitioning from a deep red at the top to a golden yellow toward the bottom. The surface of the pitcher is textured with a pattern of raised oval shapes that create a reflective, faceted look. The handle is attached to the side near the rim and is colored in a brownish-gold tone, with vertical grooves that add to its texture. There is a faint shadow beneath the pitcher, and the background is a plain, light beige color. The artist's name, "Stewart," is written in small, neat letters beneath the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
